title: AddItemSheet
description: Add `CookbookApp/ShoppingLists/AddItemSheet.swift` — a `.sheet` wrapping a `NavigationStack` (title "Add item"). Contains a `Form` with two rows: a `TextField` (item text, placeholder "e.g., 2 lemons, 500g flour") and a `.menu`-style `Picker` for aisle (options from `AisleCatalog.aisles` + a final "Other" option whose value is nil; default selection is "Other"). Toolbar: "Cancel" (leading, dismisses) and "Add" (trailing, disabled until item text non-empty after trimming). On Add: non-nil aisle calls `appendItem(_:toAisle:)`, nil calls `appendItem(_:)`, then dismisses. When `AisleCatalog.isLoaded == false`, the "Add" button is disabled and the Picker shows a "Loading aisles…" placeholder row.
acceptance_criteria: Form has a TextField for item text and a `.menu` Picker for aisle
Picker options are `AisleCatalog.aisles` in catalog order plus "Other" as the last entry and default selection
"Add" toolbar button is disabled until item text is non-empty after whitespace trimming
Sheet dismisses after a successful add and after Cancel
When `AisleCatalog.isLoaded == false`, Add is disabled and Picker shows "Loading aisles…"
